source.title: 9. All data groups by Postal code area, Year and Information
source.reference_year_notes: Table is from the folder 'Data published in 2026' (postal code area division 2026). It has a Year dimension (2010-2024); all values here are for Year=2024, the latest year in the table, for both population (HE, situation 31 December) and income (HR, TR) variables. Metadata states: 'Data in euros are given in the value of the statistical year.' Income = annual disposable monetary income in euros; HR variables concern inhabitants aged 18 or over.

median_income_person.label: Median income of inhabitants (HR)
median_income_person.note:
Median income of inhabitants (eur) is obtained by listing inhabitants by the amount ot disposable monetary income. Median income is the income of the middle inhabitant. An equal number of inhabitants remain on both sides of the middle inhabitant. 
Data in euros are given in the value of the statistical year.

avg_income_person.label: Average income of inhabitants (HR)
avg_income_person.note:
Average income of inhabitants (eur) is the average annual income of inhabitants. 
Data in euros are given in the value of the statistical year.

median_income_household.label: Median income of households (TR)
median_income_household.note:
Median income of households (eur) is obtained by listing households by the amount of disposable monetary income. Median income is the income of the middle household. An equal number of households remain on both sides of the middle household. 
Data in euros are given in the value of the statistical year.

avg_income_household.label: Average income of households (TR)
avg_income_household.note:
Average income of households (eur) is the average annual disposable monetary income of households. 
Data in euros are given in the value of the statistical year.

inhabitants.label: Inhabitants, total (HE)
inhabitants.note: Inhabitants are people residing permanently in the area. This is the radix of the data group.

avg_age.label: Average age of inhabitants (HE)
avg_age.note: Average age of inhabitants is the average age by area. In calculating the average age, six months have been added to the age of each inhabitant, and then the total age has been divided by the number of inhabitants.

table_notes:
Data protection:
Data on population structure are confidential if there are less than 30 inhabitants in the area. The value in confidential fields is '...'.

INHABITANTS' DISPOSABLE MONETARY INCOME (HR) 
Population:
Data on inhabitants' income concern people aged 18 or over. The income data are based on the disposable monetary income of inhabitants. The formation of disposable monetary income can be described as follows: 
+ wages and salaries
+ entrepreneurial income
+ property income (without imputed rent)
+ current transfers received (without imputed rent)
(= gross money income)
- current transfers paid
= disposable monetary income

Current transfers paid are mainly formed of direct taxes and social security contributions. In addition, current transfers paid include compulsory pension contributions and unemployment insurance premiums, as well as child maintenance support paid. Taxes paid do not include church tax, voluntary individual insurance premiums and indirect taxes.
Data in euros are given in the value of the statistical year.

Data protection:
Data on income are confidential if there are fewer than 30 people aged 18 or over in the area. The value in confidential fields is '...'.

HOUSEHOLDS' DISPOSABLE MONETARY INCOME (TR) 
Population:
A household is formed of people who permanently live in the same dwelling. The statistical definition for a household is household-dwelling unit. The income data are based on the disposable monetary income of households.The formation of disposable monetary income can be described as follows: 
+ wages and salaries
+ entrepreneurial income
+ property income (without imputed rent)
+ current transfers received (without imputed rent)
(= gross money income)
- current transfers paid
= disposable monetary income

Current transfers paid are mainly formed of direct taxes and social security contributions. In addition, current transfers paid include compulsory pension contributions and unemployment insurance premiums, as well as child maintenance support paid. Taxes paid do not include church tax, voluntary individual insurance premiums and indirect taxes.
Data in euros are given in the value of the statistical year.

Data protection:
Data on the income of households are confidential if there are fewer than 30 households in the area. The value in confidential fields is '...'.
